facts.fact: Law 2017-020, adopted by the National Assembly and Senate and promulgated by the President, appears in Journal Officiel no. 1400 as the law on personal data protection; the excerpt shows no commencement provision.
Article 64 creates an independent public-law Authority for Personal Data Protection attached to the Prime Minister, and Article 65 leaves its composition and appointment of members to a decree.
